Interface EventHandler

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface EventHandler
Functional interface for handling TUI events.

The event handler is called for each event received by the application. Return true to trigger a redraw, or false to skip redrawing.
